name: Constituencies of Kenya (IEBC)
source: IEBC, Registered Voters per Constituency for the 2022 General Election
notes: 290 constituencies. Names Title-Cased from the ALL CAPS source. Cross-checked: code, name and county code identical in the per-constituency and per-ward PDFs; sum of ward registered voters equals the constituency figure for all 290.
